name: Terracotta Wind-Chime Ridge

local_conflict: Breeze-piping clay sprites and bell-crest finches nest inside the resonant ceramic wind-organs.

mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What carillon sanctuary crowns the highest arch of Terracotta Wind-Chime Ridge?
